-- COUSR00C PROCESS-PAGE-FORWARD (app/cbl/COUSR00C.cbl:282-331): STARTBR (default GTEQ, 586-614)
-- + READNEXT (619-648) over USRSEC by SEC-USR-ID (KEYS(8,0), app/jcl/DUSRSECJ.jcl:65), in
-- ascending key byte order, which is the "C" collation migration 0003 gives usr_id. Audit rows
-- COUSR00C-013 to COUSR00C-018. Only the four columns POPULATE-USER-DATA shows are read, and no
-- credential column. Endpoint 16 GET /api/v1/users [A]. Rule: Bounded Pagination (users_pkey).
-- Parameters: 1 start user ID, inclusive (empty for the LOW-VALUES first page), 2 row limit.
SELECT
    usr_id,
    usr_fname,
    usr_lname,
    usr_type
FROM users
WHERE usr_id >= $1::bpchar
ORDER BY usr_id ASC
LIMIT $2::bigint
